blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why only names accountants copying invoices into a spreadsheet one by one ("Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month."); a single CSV route answers it. Drop the plugin system from the proposal, the design decision "Exports go through a plugin registry" (whose only rejected alternative, "a single CSV function (not extensible)", is rejected for an extensibility nobody requested) and task 1.2 ("Plugin registry discovering `src/export/plugins/`, verified by `npm test -- registry`", which names no observable behaviour to verify). Move PDF/XLSX/XML/JSON formats to a later change if a need appears.
findings.title: Plugin system for future export formats is scope nobody asked for

findings.evidence: - A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format.
findings.recommendation: Nothing in the Why asks for a per-user format choice, and with CSV as the only format the choice has nothing to choose from. The requirement "Users choose their export format" is also not verifiable as written: its scenario "**THEN** exports use CSV" cannot be observed differently from today, since the only route is `GET /invoices.csv`, whose format is fixed by its path. Remove the requirement, its scenarios "A preference" and "No plugin", task 2.1 and `web/src/settings/` from Impact. If it were kept, the `user-interface` domain would have to be ticked since `web/src/settings/SettingsPage.tsx` changes.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format is scope nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: The change exposes every invoice of a month, with its customer, through the new route `GET /invoices.csv?month=YYYY-MM`, yet every domain is unticked with no reason, so no expert reviews who may call the route or what customer data leaves the system. The spec has no unauthorized scenario either: it only covers "An invalid month" (400). Tick `security` and `personal-data` (or give a reason on their line), and add a scenario for an unauthenticated or unauthorized caller.
findings.title: New endpoint exposing invoice and customer data with security and personal-data unticked
